name: ztimed_task_run_immediate_draw_action
description: zTimedTask::RunImmediateAction dispatches immediate draw task payloads by kind.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke covers the kind 2 immediate-line dispatch and default ignored-kind path; other draw providers are covered by their own subsystem tests or remain provider behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL at 0x4bd4d0 shows kind-1 image blit, kind-2 immediate line, kind-3 raster polygon, kind-4 inline text, kind-5 external text pointer, kind-6 span-occlusion sample, kind-7 clipped line after HudLineClip, kind-8 clipped line strip, and default no-op behavior.
The native timed-task smoke verifies kind-2 argument forwarding into zRndr_DrawImmediateLine through the renderer raster callback and verifies an unknown kind performs no dispatch.
